title: MHADA Pune lottery is only for Pune, PCMC and PMRDA: your district has its own MHADA board (Nashik, Sambhajinagar, Nagpur...)
audience: Marathi families outside Pune (Nashik, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Nagpur, Wardha, Amravati) who saw our MHADA Pune reels and asked about their district, 22-50
message: The MHADA Pune lottery's homes are only in Pune city, PCMC and PMRDA; Nashik, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Nagpur (Wardha too), Amravati, Konkan and Mumbai have their own MHADA boards and their own lotteries; all of them come on MHADA's one official site; follow us and we will post when one opens.
facts: The homes in the MHADA Pune board lottery 2026 are only in Pune city, Pimpri-Chinchwad and the PMRDA area. Source: MHADA Pune board lottery advertisement, as reported by Lokmat Times.
MHADA works through regional boards: Mumbai, Konkan, Pune, Nashik, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Nagpur and Amravati; each board holds its own lottery for homes in its region. Source: MHADA.
Wardha district comes under the Nagpur board; Waluj (Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar) under the Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar board.
Every board's lottery is announced and applied for on MHADA's one official housing site.
As of 18 October 2026 we did not find an open lottery announced by the Nashik, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Nagpur or Amravati boards.
Applications are made only on MHADA's official site; nobody needs to be paid to apply.

shots.voice: नाशिक, वर्धा, संभाजीनगरमध्ये MHADA घरं आहेत का?

shots.voice: या पुणे लॉटरीतली घरं फक्त पुणे, PCMC आणि PMRDA भागात.

shots.prompt: A man in his 40s in a town outside Pune reading a newspaper at a tea stall in the morning, calm, no readable text on the paper.
shots.voice: वर्धा नागपूर मंडळात, वाळूज संभाजीनगर मंडळात येतं.

shots.prompt: A young couple at home at night looking at a phone together with a calm, patient expression, a plain wall behind them, the phone screen blurred and unreadable.
shots.voice: 18 ऑक्टोबरपर्यंत या मंडळांची नवी लॉटरी आम्हाला दिसली नाही.

shots.prompt: The same woman from the first shot smiling at her phone on a balcony at golden hour, a few plants in pots, hopeful.
shots.voice: लॉटरी आली की आम्ही सांगू. फॉलो करा, मित्रांना पाठवा.

hook: MHADA: नाशिक, संभाजीनगर, नागपूरमध्ये घरं? उत्तर इथे
caption:
MHADA lottery Nashik Sambhajinagar Nagpur Amravati | म्हाडा: तुमच्या जिल्ह्याची लॉटरी कुठे?

आमच्या MHADA पुणे व्हिडिओवर अनेकांनी विचारलं: नाशिक, वर्धा, संभाजीनगर, वाळूजमध्ये घरं आहेत का?

📍 MHADA पुणे लॉटरी 2026 मधील घरं फक्त पुणे शहर, पिंपरी-चिंचवड आणि PMRDA भागात आहेत.
🏛️ नाशिक, छत्रपती संभाजीनगर, नागपूर, अमरावती, कोकण आणि मुंबई यांचं स्वतःचं MHADA मंडळ आहे आणि स्वतःची लॉटरी.
🗺️ वर्धा: नागपूर मंडळ · वाळूज: छत्रपती संभाजीनगर मंडळ
📅 18 ऑक्टोबरपर्यंत या मंडळांची नवी लॉटरी आम्हाला दिसली नाही.

🔔 तुमच्या मंडळाची लॉटरी जाहीर झाली की आम्ही लगेच पोस्ट करू. फॉलो करा आणि तुमचा जिल्हा कमेंटमध्ये लिहा.

🌐 सर्व मंडळांच्या लॉटरी MHADA च्या अधिकृत साइटवर: https://housing.mhada.gov.in/
⚠️ अर्जासाठी कोणालाही पैसे देऊ नका.

व्हिडिओतील छायाचित्रे प्रतीकात्मक आहेत.

reply_faq.q: Is there a MHADA lottery in Nashik, Sambhajinagar, Nagpur, Wardha, Amravati, Waluj or my district now?
reply_faq.a: The current MHADA Pune lottery is only for Pune city, PCMC and PMRDA. Your district comes under its own MHADA board (Wardha: Nagpur board; Waluj: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar board). As of 18 October we did not find an open lottery on those boards; we will post when one is announced.

reply_faq.q: Can someone from another district apply in the Pune lottery?
reply_faq.a: The homes are in Pune, PCMC and PMRDA. Anyone with a Maharashtra domicile certificate (15 years' residence) who meets the income limit can apply, but the home will be in the Pune area.

reply_faq.q: Where will the lottery for my board be announced?
reply_faq.a: On MHADA's official housing site, the same site for every board. Follow us too: we will post when your board announces one.
